source.quote: The 5th and 7th houses from the lagna or the Moon be flourished if they are associated with or aspected by benefics or their lords, if it is not so, they will not be fruitful.
source.quote_display: The 5th and 7th houses from the lagna or the Moon be flourished if they are associated with or aspected by benefics or their lords, if it is not so, they will not be fruitful.

cards.note: "Associated with or aspected by benefics or their lords" is read as four sufficient supports per house: a benefic occupant, a full benefic aspect, the house's own lord occupying it, or its own lord aspecting it. The lagna frame only is encoded; dep.moon-frame is no longer listed because the alternative frame is recorded as an exclusion rather than a blocker -- the card is sound in the frame it does use.
exclusions: The Moon-frame alternative ("the 5th and 7th ... from the Moon") is not encoded, so the card under-fires on charts that satisfy the verse only in that frame.
The negative tail -- "if it is not so, they will not be fruitful" -- is a separate assertion and is not claimed by this card.

Under-fires on benefics: the encoded corpus classifies only the waxing Moon and Mercury-not-with-malefics as benefic, because Phaladeepika states the full benefic list in chapter 4, which is not encoded. Jupiter and Venus therefore carry no nature fact and cannot satisfy a benefic clause here.

source.quote: If there be malefics in the 12th, 4th and 8th houses or if Venus be hemmed in between two malefics or if Venus be associated or aspected by malefics the native will lose his wife (his wife will die).
source.quote_display: If there be malefics in the 12th, 4th and 8th houses or if Venus be hemmed in between two malefics or if Venus be associated or aspected by malefics the native will lose his wife (his wife will die).

cards.note: Four alternative conditions in the verse, three of them now expressible. "Malefics in the 12th, 4th and 8th houses" was previously called inexpressible and is not: dep.nature-occupancy states it directly, and the three houses are conjoined as printed. Association is same-sign conjunction and aspect is full drishti, each with the malefic named by a bound variable so the claim says which graha afflicts Venus.
exclusions: The hemming branch ("Venus be hemmed in between two malefics") is omitted: Phaladeepika defines the flanking houses in chapter 6, which is not encoded, so the engine has no sourced definition of "between". Being one arm of a disjunction, its absence only makes the card under-fire.
Aspect means full drishti only, per the engine's aspect choice.

source.quote: If the lord of the 7th house occupies the 5th, the native will lose his wife or he will become sonless.
source.quote_display: If the lord of the 7th house occupies the 5th, the native will lose his wife or he will become sonless.

cards.note: The variable binds the same graha across both leaves, which is the whole content of the rule: not any lord and any placement, but the lord of the 7th in the 5th.

source.quote: If the lord of the 5th or the 8th be in the 7th, the wife of the native does not survive.
source.quote_display: If the lord of the 5th or the 8th be in the 7th, the wife of the native does not survive.

cards.note: Two independent lordships, each bound separately.

source.quote: If the weak Moon be in the 5th and the malefics occupy the Ascendant, 7th and 12th houses the person concerned will be without wife and children.
source.quote_display: If the weak Moon be in the 5th and the malefics occupy the Ascendant, 7th and 12th houses the person concerned will be without wife and children.

cards.note: The Moon-in-5th leaf is exact; 'weak' and the malefic occupancy of three houses are not expressible, so the card must not fire on the placement alone.

source.quote: If Mars and Saturn be in the 7th from the Venus and Moon in any nativity, the person concerned will be wifeless and childless.
source.quote_display: If Mars and Saturn be in the 7th from the Venus and Moon in any nativity, the person concerned will be wifeless and childless.

cards.note: Now in the frame the verse actually uses. "The 7th from the Venus and Moon" is genuinely ambiguous -- it may mean the 7th from each separately, or Mars from one and Saturn from the other. The reading encoded is the one every interpretation agrees on: both malefics in the 7th from both reference bodies. It under-fires and never over-fires.
exclusions: The distributive readings (Mars in the 7th from Venus while Saturn is in the 7th from the Moon, or either malefic from either body alone) are not encoded.

source.quote: If there be a hermaphrodite planet in the 7th house, and the 11th house is occupied by two planets, the person concerned will have two wives.
source.quote_display: If there be a hermaphrodite planet in the 7th house, and the 11th house is occupied by two planets, the person concerned will have two wives.

cards.note: "Hermaphrodite" is read as the `eunuch` class of PD.02.GrahaSex (Mercury, Ketu, Saturn) -- an encoding judgement about two words for one classification, recorded here rather than made silently. The count of two in the 11th is literal, exactly as printed.

source.quote: A person will have two wives in the event of both the lord of the 7th and Venus being posited in a dual sign or amsa.
source.quote_display: A person will have two wives in the event of both the lord of the 7th and Venus being posited in a dual sign or amsa.

cards.note: The verse offers 'a dual sign or amsa'. Only the sign branch is tested, so the card is sound but not complete: it fires when the rule certainly holds and stays silent when it might hold by navamsa. Under-firing, never over-firing.
exclusions: the navamsa branch of 'dual sign or amsa' is not tested

source.quote: The number of wives should be generally ascertained from the number of planets that are in conjunction with the lord of 7th house and Venus.
source.quote_display: The number of wives should be generally ascertained from the number of planets that are in conjunction with the lord of 7th house and Venus.

cards.note: "The number of planets that are in conjunction with the lord of 7th house and Venus" is read as two counts, one per graha, both bound and both reported. The alternative reading -- planets conjunct *both* at once -- is narrower and the text does not choose between them, so the two numbers are given rather than a single derived one.
exclusions: Fires only where both the 7th lord and Venus have at least one companion; conjunct_count is not emitted for a graha that sits alone, so a chart where either is unaccompanied yields no claim.

source.quote: The native will associate with as many women as is the number of planets posited in the 7th house. The number of women, who will die, will be equal to the number of malefics, and the number of benefics will represent the number of women who will survive.
source.quote_display: The native will associate with as many women as is the number of planets posited in the 7th house. The number of women, who will die, will be equal to the number of malefics, and the number of benefics will represent the number of women who will survive.

cards.note: A counting rule, not a categorical one. `?n` binds to the number of grahas the chart puts in the 7th and the claim reports that number. Only the first sentence is conditioned: the split of that number into malefics (who die) and benefics (who survive) is carried by nature_count facts in the trace but is not asserted as a separate claim, because one card yields one effect.
exclusions: The malefic/benefic breakdown in the second and third sentences is not separately claimed.

source.quote: Benefics in the 7th house will produce good effects unless they happen to be lords of the 6th, 8th or 12th house.
source.quote_display: Benefics in the 7th house will produce good effects unless they happen to be lords of the 6th, 8th or 12th house.

cards.note: The "unless" is the whole difficulty. It excludes the benefic that satisfied the first clause, not any graha anywhere, so the negation has to see the current binding -- dep.correlated-negation. Without it the condition asked whether anything at all rules the 6th, 8th or 12th, which is true of every chart, and the card could never fire.

source.quote: If malefics in their signs of debilitation be posited in the 2nd, 7th and 8th, in female's nativity the disposition will make her a widow and in a man's chart, it will render him a widower.
source.quote_display: If malefics in their signs of debilitation be posited in the 2nd, 7th and 8th, in female's nativity the disposition will make her a widow and in a man's chart, it will render him a widower.

cards.note: Encoded as printed: "in the 2nd, 7th and 8th", so a debilitated malefic is required in each of the three houses. That is a demanding condition and many astrologers read the list as a disjunction, but the text says "and" and the conjunctive reading cannot over-fire. The effect is stated for both sexes in one sentence, so no scope.sex is set and the quote carries the distinction.
exclusions: The disjunctive reading (a debilitated malefic in any one of the 2nd, 7th or 8th) is not encoded.

source.quote: If the lord of the 7th be posited in his sign of debilitation, be in an inimical sign, be combust or be aspected by a malefic and the 7th house be occupied or aspected by a malefic, there will be loss of wife. So say the men well versed in the science of Astrology.
source.quote_display: If the lord of the 7th be posited in his sign of debilitation, be in an inimical sign, be combust or be aspected by a malefic and the 7th house be occupied or aspected by a malefic, there will be loss of wife. So say the men well versed in the science of Astrology.

cards.note: Two conjoined requirements, each satisfiable several ways: the 7th lord must be afflicted (debilitated, combust, or aspected by a malefic) and the 7th house must itself be occupied or aspected by a malefic. Both arms bind through ?l so the affliction and the lordship are the same graha. Kept separate from PD.10.WifeDeprived.Lord7Afflicted because the book states the rule twice and attributes this one.
exclusions: The "be in an inimical sign" arm is omitted: natural friendship is dep.dignity-friendship, still unresolved, so no inimical-sign fact exists. One arm of a disjunction, so the card under-fires only.
Aspect means full drishti only, per the engine's aspect choice.
